question: What designation is given when yet another spire is placed on the bhadra?
premises: Another spire is placed again on the bhadra.
This continues the series of additions.
The resulting form is called Vijayānanda.
inference: Placing yet another spire on the bhadra produces the form called Vijayānanda.
plain_english: If one should place yet another spire on the bhadra, it is called Vijayānanda.
